title: CLI: JSON mode exit code inconsistent for no results
description:
When using --json flag, the exit code is 1 even when there are no results. The JSON output correctly shows status: "no_results" which indicates successful completion with empty results. Exit code 1 is inconsistent with the JSON status.

## Reproduction
```
$ doc_transformer search 'nonexistent' --index-dir /tmp/test_index --json
{
  "status": "no_results",
  "query": "nonexistent",
  ...
}
Exit: 1
``"

Expected: Exit code 0 (JSON successfully shows no_results status)
Actual: Exit code 1
